Generated from
[software.bib](https://github.com/DanPalBCM/career-hub/blob/main/software.bib),
the canonical record. Each entry's note states whether the repository is an
original or a fork, and whether it is public or private. Papers are referenced
by DOI; see [Publications](publications.qmd) for the full citations.

## Original, public — companions to papers

@sw-clinical-clinpreai-benchmarks — ClinPreAI benchmarks.
Companion to DOI 10.1101/2025.11.14.25340265.

@sw-clinical-antepartum-ppd-prediction — antepartum hospitalization and
postpartum depression. Companion to DOI 10.1002/pmf2.70319.

@sw-clinical-trofinetide — Trofinetide / Rett syndrome phenotyping.
Companion to a manuscript under review.

@sw-ml-nasa-nlp — space hardware failure reporting.
Companion to DOI 10.1038/s41598-026-36813-7.

@sw-superconducting-diode-effect — asymmetric supercurrents.
Companion to DOI 10.1103/PhysRevB.108.094513.

## Original, public — other

@sw-clinical-diabetes-t1d-t2d — pediatric Type 1 / Type 2 diabetes EHR
analysis. Code only; no patient data.

## Forks (working copies; upstream licenses)

@sw-ammper — agent-based model of microbial populations exposed to radiation;
used with the NASA BioSentinel and LEIA missions.

@sw-medsdoh — OHNLP-based social determinants of health extraction.
Companion to DOI 10.64898/2026.04.27.26351699.

@sw-overlapplots — R package for gene expression variation in neurological
disease.

## Private / cite-only

@sw-tch-mentormatching — private fork of LiuzLab/tch-mentormatching;
available on request.

@sw-phi-scrubber-evaluation — private lab repository; the link resolves for
people with access. No public mirror.
